_note: Ratchet thresholds for scripts/corpus_diversity.py --gate. Every threshold records the values actually MEASURED on the clean baseline and on the known-bad corpus (archive/fable-upgrade), and must sit strictly between them: the baseline passes, the known-bad corpus fails. tests/test_corpus_diversity.py enforces that betweenness mechanically, so a threshold cannot be quietly loosened to make a failing change pass -- loosening one breaks the test. Metrics are evaluated and reported INDIVIDUALLY; there is deliberately no aggregate score, because a blended number is exactly how the Fable regression stayed invisible. Absolute (not relative) thresholds are used so the gate works on any ref without needing a reference artifact; mean_words is used instead of total_words so the gate is independent of agent count.

reference.known_bad_description: Autonomous mass upgrade that rewrote 263 of 264 agents. All existing validation passed.

pairwise.median_pct.rationale: A healthy library has a median of exactly zero -- most agent pairs share no 8-word run at all. Any nonzero median means shared phrasing has spread corpus-wide.

pairwise.p95_pct.rationale: Still exactly zero at the baseline: even the 95th-percentile pair shares nothing. Moves off zero as soon as a template spreads.

pairwise.p99_pct.rationale: The upper tail of the distribution. Rose 839% under the known-bad upgrade while the maximum did not move.

pairwise.mean_of_max_per_file_pct.rationale: Averaged over ALL agents including the 106 whose max similarity is exactly zero. Averaging over nonzero agents only inflates the figure and moves for the wrong reason.

vocabulary.headers_in_50pct_files.rationale: Section headers shared by most of the library. Converging on one template shows up here before the prose looks alike.

vocabulary.headers_in_75pct_files.rationale: Near-universal headers. The known-bad upgrade added 'analytical discipline' (89% of files) and 'negative constraints never violate' (78%).

size.mean_words.rationale: Instruction bloat is a tracked regression, not a neutral fact. Per-agent rather than corpus total so the gate is independent of how many agents exist.

boilerplate.shared_blocks.rationale: Distinct 12-word runs appearing verbatim in 3 or more files.

boilerplate.duplicated_word_pct.rationale: Share of corpus words sitting inside a run repeated across files. The sharpest detector in the set -- moved ~15x more than any similarity percentile, because a template fragment spread across many files barely shifts pairwise similarity but shows up immediately as duplicated words.

pairwise.max_pct.rationale: NEGATIVE CONTROL -- not a homogenization detector. This is the statistic scripts/check-agent-originality.sh gates on (WARN 20%, FAIL 40%), and it moved by 0.0113 percentage points across the known-bad upgrade. It is retained at the existing WARN threshold so the gate output shows it PASSING on a corpus that fails nine other dimensions, making visible why maximum pairwise similarity cannot detect this failure mode. Exempt from the strictly-between test because it sits above both observations by design.
